senses.gloss: m.(b. h. מוֹרָג , מוֹרִג; cmp. אָרַג Pi.)
an implement with grooves or indentations, esp. threshing sledge.—Pl. מוֹרִיגִים, מוֹרִגִּים.
units: Zeb. 116ᵇ; Men. 22ᵃ; Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ (expl. מורגים, II Sam. XXIV, 22) , v. טוּרְבִּיל.—2) palate (Rashi: all parts of the animal which are rough and indented).—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55a">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 81a:8">Sabb. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מוֹרִיגֵי בהמה</he> the palate (or tongue &c.) of an animal.
